description: This file defines the AdministrationController class for SuiteCRM, handling administrative actions such as saving tab configurations, language settings, global search settings, and triggering sprite rebuilds.

classes.name: AdministrationController
classes.description: Controller class handling administrative actions in SuiteCRM including configuration updates and sprite rebuilding.

methods.name: action_savetabs
methods.description: Handles saving user-specific and system tab configurations, including hidden tabs and permissions.

methods.name: action_savelanguages
methods.description: Saves language enable/disable settings and redirects accordingly.

methods.name: action_saveglobalsearchsettings
methods.description: Saves the global search configuration settings.

methods.name: mergeFtsConfig
methods.description: Merges current full-text search engine configuration with new parameters.

methods.name: action_UpdateAjaxUI
methods.description: Updates the AJAX UI configuration, specifically banned modules.

methods.name: action_callRebuildSprites
methods.description: Triggers the sprite rebuild process via the SugarSpriteBuilder.
